title: Clean default-feature warnings in README vector smoke commands
why: The README-style `cargo run -p omnisstream_cli -- verify/inspect ...` commands pass, but default-feature builds emit existing warnings from `crates/omnisstream/src/repo.rs` and `crates/omnisstream/src/compression.rs`. The all-feature clippy path is clean, so this is best handled as a focused follow-up.
suggested_scope: Adjust `ingest_one_part` so `stored` and `compression_alg` are only mutable when the `compression` feature is enabled, or split the feature-gated paths cleanly.
Gate or reshape `CompressionConfig`/`set_compression_config` so default-feature builds do not report dead code warnings.
